2609.21667.title: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
2609.21667.paper_summary: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility reports of the SIGMOD Availability and Reproducibility Initiative (ARI). This yields a curated corpus of 4,397 $\langle$DOI, repository-URL$\rangle$ pairs. We design two distinct application profiles grounded in Wikidata classes (one for scholarly articles, one for software instances) aligned with the schema.org and CodeMeta vocabularies. This architectural separation enables rule-based reconciliation at two granularities: lightweight, inline publication references or standalone, first-class Wikidata software nodes equipped with SWHIDs, Software Heritage's content-addressed identifiers. A read-only lookup against Wikidata shows that only 82 of the harvested repositories were already modelled there; human-reviewed batches have since created 4{,}182 new software items cross-linked to their articles. We further show that payloads of the emerging COAR Notify protocol, an external effort we do not develop, map natively onto our input format, so the same backend could later serve a live enrichment stream. Our core contribution is a pair of application profiles that turn Wikidata into a connector between the scholarly record and archived source code; we openly release all code, application profiles, and harvested datasets.
2609.21667.paper_summary_zh: 軟體是一種一流的科學對象，但在連結開放數據（LOD）雲中，源代碼與學術記錄之間的驗證連結仍然大多缺失，將存檔的文物與語義發現隔離開來。本文提出了一個端到端的對帳管道，從那些論文與其源代碼之間的連結明確且經編輯驗證的來源中，收集、驗證並建模出版物與資料庫的對應關係：以軟體為中心的期刊 JOSS、SoftwareX 和 IPOL，以及 SIGMOD 可用性與可重現性倡議（ARI）的可重現性報告。這產生了一個經過策劃的語料庫，包含 4,397 $\langle$DOI, repository-URL$\rangle$ 對。我们设计了两个不同的应用程序配置文件，基于Wikidata类别（一个用于学术文章，一个用于软件实例），与schema.org和CodeMeta词汇对齐。这种架构分离使得在两个粒度上进行基于规则的对账成为可能：轻量级的行内出版物引用或独立的、一流的Wikidata软件节点，配备SWHIDs，即软件遗产的内容寻址标识符。对Wikidata的只读查找显示，只有82个收集到的资料库已经在那里建模；经过人工审查的批次随后创建了4{,}182个与其文章交叉链接的新软件项目。我们进一步展示了新兴的COAR Notify协议的有效载荷，这是一个我们不开发的外部努力，原生映射到我们的输入格式，因此同一后端可以稍后提供实时丰富流。我们的核心贡献是一对应用程序配置文件，将Wikidata转变为学术记录与存档源代码之间的连接器；我们公开发布所有代码、应用程序配置文件和收集的数据集。
